model: same explicitly approved endpoint/model for all variants; historical dots3-note-prev name alone is insufficient
preflight: Human approves provider, request limits, both USD caps and permission to send the frozen source samples.
Obtain gateway billing rules for input, cached input, output and reasoning; record currency and date.
Use provider-side hard spending quotas. Client stop-after-response alone cannot guarantee a dollar ceiling.
Verify the gateway supports the same bounded output policy in both modes; inability to bound spending blocks live execution.
Freeze source segment IDs, reference context, glossary and reviewer rubric. Preserve currently required QA/review; do not modify user jobs.

Validate sample coverage for terminology, repeated names, pronouns, numbers, placeholders, links, citations and long paragraphs; replace missing coverage before authorization, then freeze the manifest.
Disable reuse only in isolated experimental tasks and report cache misses; never mutate production TM/cache.

batching.manifest_status: candidate windows; coverage validation and boundary-preserving plan must be frozen before live use
batching.ordering: seed 20261026, balanced interleaving of variants per source window; record actual order
batching.comparison: Report latency and tokens separately from parse success, defects and blinded human acceptance; do not extrapolate fixed per-call latency to a whole book.

reasoning.controls: Exact same per-role prompt, schema, sampling and supported output ceiling for each pair; no model switch, no automatic risk routing.
reasoning.reviewer: No inherited thinking_disabled control in current runtime. Any explicit reviewer-mode trial is separate and requires its own quality/authorization protocol.
reasoning.unknown_gateway_behavior: A successful response or HTTP 200 does not prove disabled thinking was honored. Require returned usage or provider evidence; otherwise mark enforcement unknown.

hard_failures: missing or duplicate required segment IDs
quality_acceptance.semantic_assessment: Blinded bilingual review of accuracy, additions/omissions, names, terminology, tone and cross-window reference chains; paired adjudication of any regression. No calibrated composite score is invented.
quality_acceptance.statistical_limit: Small bounded pilot can reject an unsafe candidate; passing it does not prove book-wide non-inferiority.

stop_conditions: Before dispatch, reserve the maximum supported cost and one logical/HTTP attempt allowance; stop if any cap would be exceeded.
Stop the affected variant on the first hard quality failure; retain the failed result for blind adjudication without automatic retry.
Stop on two consecutive 429/5xx/connection failures or provider capability rejection; do not compensate by raising concurrency.
Pause a block when baseline P95 drifts over 25 percent across paired blocks; investigate load rather than attribute it to batching. With too few observations, mark drift uncertain.
Stop on user cancellation, persistence failure, missing usage needed for budget control, hard quota exhaustion or unsupported output bounds.
Stop larger-batch exploration when item caps erase meaningful request-count gains, or repeat trials remain inconclusive; do not promote based on mock speed.
